meta.source: DECA/MBA Research performance indicator PDFs posted July 2026 (BAC, BMA, FINANCE, Hospitality, MKT, ENT).
notes: Tier 1 text is taken from the cluster PDFs because BAC.pdf has a damaged text layer (ligature glyphs); codes and levels were verified identical across all five sources.
A PI code can appear in more than one pool (e.g., Tier 2 and a Tier 3 pathway). Deduplicate by `code` when selecting PIs for a single role-play.
`display_text` is the form DECA prints on role-plays: no code, no level, example-list parentheticals removed, trailing period.
The ENT list is not tiered. Its `source_section` shows which core family each PI came from.

PQ.name: Prerequisite
PQ.meaning: Employability and job-survival skills: work ethic, appearance, basic business behavior.

CS.name: Career Sustaining
CS.meaning: Skills needed to keep a job / continue studying business; applies basic academics and business skills.

SP.name: Specialist
SP.meaning: In-depth understanding and skill in a business function.

SU.name: Supervisor
SU.meaning: Supervising others: hiring, training, scheduling, handling staff issues.
SU.defined_in: MBA Research framework (not defined in the PDFs; appears only in ENT.pdf)

MN.name: Manager
MN.meaning: Managing a function/department: planning, budgeting, policy, strategy.
MN.defined_in: MBA Research framework (appears in ENT.pdf and 6 HRM-pathway PIs)

ON.name: Owner/Entrepreneur
ON.meaning: Starting and owning a venture: feasibility, financing, legal setup, exit.
ON.defined_in: MBA Research framework (appears only in ENT.pdf)
